title: Silicon wafer close view
description:
A wafer is a slice of a huge silicon monocristal on which integrated circuits manufacturers engrave micro- and nano-electronic circuits using photolithography process.
Nowadays, ultraviolet lasers allows us to engrave those circuits with nanometric precision, making several billions of transistors to be engraved on a single penny-sized portion of silicon.
author: Le hollandais volant

Silicon wafer close view
A wafer is a slice of a huge silicon monocristal on which integrated circuits manufacturers engrave micro- and nano-electronic circuits using photolithography process.
Nowadays, ultraviolet lasers allows us to engrave those circuits with nanometric precision, making several billions of transistors to be engraved on a single penny-sized portion of silicon.
